item.title: From Hemkosh to Heritage: Remembering Hemchandra Goswami
item.description: New Delhi witnessed a meaningful tribute to one of Assam’s greatest literary icons as the 154th birth anniversary of Pandit Hemchandra Goswami was observed on Friday at the India International Centre. The programme, titled “Language and Legacy”, was organised by the Pandit Hemchandra Goswami Foundation to celebrate his immense contributions to Assamese language, literature and cultural heritage. item.title: Interim Committee Formed by 17 Student Bodies to Pursue Justice for Anjel Chakma
item.description: Seventeen student organisations from across the Northeast convened in New Delhi and formed an Interim Committee to pursue justice and stronger safeguards for students from the region, following the death of Anjel Chakma. item.title: Gujrat: Seven Earthquakes Strike Rajkot in 11 Hours, Residents Flee Homes in Panic
item.description: Multiple earthquakes struck parts of the Rajkot district on Friday morning, causing widespread panic among residents of Jetpur, Dhoraji, Upleta, and surrounding areas. People reported feeling a series of tremors in quick succession, with as many as seven quakes occurring between 6:19 am and 8:34 am, prompting many to rush out of their homes and seek safety in open spaces. item.title: India to Get V2V Tech for Improved Road Safety by 2026 End: Nitin Gadkari
item.description: The Centre is preparing to introduce Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication technology nationwide by the end of 2026, a move aimed at significantly improving road safety and reducing accidents. The system will enable vehicles to communicate directly with each other without relying on a mobile or internet network. item.title: Assam: Conmen Caught Duping Sootea Youths in Name of Govt Schemes
item.description: In an example of police-civilian cooperation, two conmen were nabbed by the police in Assam’s Sootea on accusations of fraud with the help of their victims on Friday.
